Primary request: create ONE clean standalone knee-up portrait sprite of Ikki Kurogane, upright relaxed posture, shown nearly front-on but turning his chest and face slightly toward viewer's RIGHT. Both arms hang naturally and both hands are relaxed at his sides. Friendly neutral closed-mouth expression.
Preserve: his tousled short BLACK hair, gray-brown eyes, exact youthful face identity and ordinary teenage body proportions, WHITE academy jacket with dark edging and gray patterned lapels, black high-neck underlayer, black horizontal upper-arm straps and dark trousers, accurate white/black anime uniform design.

Composition: single person centered with clear uncut hair silhouette and both hands visible, knee-up dialogue portrait, ideally portrait canvas 1024 x 1536 with generous transparent margins.
Background: actual alpha transparency, no backdrop, no paper, no texture, no shadow.
Avoid: weapon, sword, action pose, raised finger, speech bubble, panel, letters, logo, text, duplicate people, chibi proportions, heavy blush, open mouth, 3D rendering, floor shadow.

notes: Single youthful black-haired character, white and black uniform, relaxed hands, friendly closed-mouth face.
Source face identity and uniform retained as close visual guidance, generated reinterpretation.
